# 민성 한의학 아카이브

> 본초·방제·고전·사상의학·침구·질환·현대 임상연구를 상호 연결한 한의학 지식 아카이브.

Base URL: https://wiki.minseong.co.kr/

## Editorial approach
Traditional Korean medicine concepts are presented in their historical and clinical context. Modern clinical evidence is separated from traditional use and linked to research identifiers such as PMID and DOI when available.
